title: i know a spot
medium: Illustration, HTML, one neighbourhood at a time
note: An illustrated guide to a city that hides too much of itself in plain sight. The artists report the work may never be finished. Delhi has offered no comment.

title: bhai se poocho
medium: Large language model, one-sided parasocial devotion
note: A machine that answers any pareshani in the manner of a certain gentleman of Bandra. The Museum notes, for legal reasons, that the work is not affiliated with Mr. Khan.

title: Old Internet
note: Renders the Twitter of 2006, before the feed knew your name. Side effects include nostalgia and a sudden urge to print emails. Y2K tested.
